newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products mixed - gas oil down with futures.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products mixed - gas oil down with futures.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Friday, traders said.
Gas oil retreated in line with easier futures. Front month July IPE ended down $2.50 at $162 a tonne.
The heating oil market was long, with Russian 0.2 percent heating oil assessed slightly lower at cif high quotes +$1.50/$2 cif Genoa.
Traders said they saw early signs that Tempotrade had been awarded one 25,000 tonne cargo of 0.7 percent sulphur gas oil in a Turkish tender for late July delivery. Prices details were not available.
There were unconfirmed reports of a U.S. major buying a cracked cargo into Gibraltar at about high cif Med plus $1.

One or two other cargoes were heard on offer and no fresh Russian material was coming out from the Black Sea, traders said, adding buyers were waiting until next week to see if fuel prices come down in line with crude.
A Spanish refinery said it was looking for high sulphur cracked material to go into its own system but was waiting for prices to come off.
"The premiums they are asking in the north are a little high for us," a trader with the refiner said.
Low sulphur cargoes were weaker with very little buying interest seen after a Spanish refiner recently found no one to take its cargo and moved it internally.
An Italian buyer was heard to have bid $105 cif for a cargo, or $1 lower on earlier levels, but no deals were heard done.
